traditions.name: Stoicism
traditions.note: Western Hellenistic philosophy; included for comparison, not classified as Eastern.

traditions.name: Early Buddhist / Nikaya traditions
traditions.note: Keep early canonical material distinct from later Buddhist schools.

traditions.name: Mahayana / Chan / Zen
traditions.note: Zen is one Buddhist tradition, not a synonym for all Japanese or Buddhist philosophy.

traditions.name: Hindu / Indian philosophical traditions
traditions.note: Do not collapse Vedanta, Yoga, Samkhya, and other schools into one generic metaphysics.

traditions.name: Classical Daoism
traditions.note: Classical texts and later religious Daoism are related but not identical.

traditions.name: Confucian traditions
traditions.note: Do not reduce Confucian self-cultivation to generic productivity.

traditions.name: Jaina philosophy
traditions.note: Core themes include nonviolence, non-attachment, and many-sidedness.

traditions.name: Epicureanism
traditions.note: Western Hellenistic philosophy included for comparative reading.
